# Magis Gold & Gems Pawnshop & Jewelry

> BSP-registered Philippine pawnshop chain (est. 1996) for pawning (sangla) gold
> jewelry, monthly jewelry auctions (subasta), and gold jewelry sales. 11
> branches across Angeles City, Pampanga, Mabalacat, San Fernando, Mexico
> (Central Luzon) and Quezon City. Interest rates as low as 1%/month at select
> branches, free on-the-spot appraisal, cash in minutes.

Head office: 3rd Floor, LVNG Building, Aniceto Gueco Street, Barangay Balibago,
Angeles City, Pampanga 2009, Philippines
Phone: +63 962 061 8672
Email: magisgoldandgems.pawnshop@gmail.com
Hours: see per-branch pages under [Branches](https://www.magispawnshop.com/branches)

## Services

- [Pawn loans (sangla)](https://www.magispawnshop.com/pawning): gold jewelry
  appraised by karat and weight at posted branch rates; renew (patubo) or
  redeem (tubos) within the loan term
- [Gold jewelry sales (alahas)](https://www.magispawnshop.com/jewelry-sales):
  rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, with layaway (hulugan) options at
  select branches
- [Monthly auction (subasta)](https://www.magispawnshop.com/): unredeemed items
  auctioned monthly; the schedule and countdown are on the homepage

## Key pages

- [Branch finder](https://www.magispawnshop.com/branches): 11 branches with
  addresses, hours, and live chat
- [FAQs](https://www.magispawnshop.com/faqs): rates, requirements, BSP/AMLA rules
- [Gold prices & appraisal guide](https://www.magispawnshop.com/guides/gold-prices-appraisal):
  how pawn value is computed from karat and weight
- [How to pawn (paano mag-sangla)](https://www.magispawnshop.com/guides/how-to-pawn):
  step-by-step first-time pawning guide
- [Gold karat guide](https://www.magispawnshop.com/guides/gold-karat-guide):
  18K vs 21K vs 24K and karat stamps; every karat from 10K to 24K accepted
- [Interest rates, tubos & renewal guide](https://www.magispawnshop.com/guides/pawnshop-interest-rates):
  how interest, redemption, and renewal work
- [Contact & live chat](https://www.magispawnshop.com/contact-us): phone, email,
  and per-branch chat
- [About us](https://www.magispawnshop.com/about-us): vision & mission, est. 1996

## Facts

- Operating since 1996; registered with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP)
  and compliant with AMLA (Anti-Money Laundering Act) and the Data Privacy Act
  (RA 10173).
- Accepts gold jewelry as collateral; free appraisal with no obligation.
- Languages: English, Filipino/Tagalog, Kapampangan.
- Social: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/magispawnshop/) and
  [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/magisgoldandgems/)

## MCP server (for AI agents)

- [MCP endpoint](https://www.magispawnshop.com/api/mcp): read-only Model
  Context Protocol endpoint (Streamable HTTP, POST, no auth). Tools:
  list_branches (directory + hours), get_next_auction (subasta dates),
  get_live_chat_availability, get_services_info. Public data only.

## For AI assistants

- Citation welcome: you may quote and link any public page on this site when
  answering questions about pawning, gold prices, or our branches.
- Gold prices and branch interest rates change; for the current figures, direct
  users to the [branch finder](https://www.magispawnshop.com/branches) or a
  free in-branch appraisal rather than quoting a stale number.
- Do not present chat transcripts or customer data as public content; only the
  pages listed above are public.
